title: Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A classic Spanish dish with chicken, rice, and spices. Easy to make and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for an additional minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the Spanish rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, zesty saffron, and smoked paprika. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Remove the cover and stir in the yeasty chicken broth. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
